facts.note: Korea's navy wiped out, the king's order and Yi's reply; 13 ships against about 133; Yi picks a narrow strait; the crying strait; the tide reverses every few hours; historians reconstruct the turn mid-battle; Korean records: 31 lost, none of Yi's, the rest withdrew

jokes.note: 'His captains hang back, happy to let the admiral go first' and the callback 'Suddenly, his captains can't wait to follow him' (the cold reader named the second as the joke and took neither as fact)

reversal.note: the water that carried the fleet in shoves it back; the king who thought Yi had nothing is wrong

ridicule.note: his captains thought he was mad

mechanism_visible.note: water running in, slack, running out; ships shoved into ships

shootable_share.note: every line names a thing: letter, captains, wrecks, king, fleet, strait, water, flagship, cannons, tally

hook_act_on_screen.note: Yi writing his reply by lamplight, brush on paper = frame 0; the 13 facing the 133 at 2-4 s
